_comment_model: No apiKeyEnvVar on purpose: that field means 'the host WRITES the resolved MODEL-ROUTING key here' (see openclaw: LITELLM_API_KEY). CURSOR_API_KEY is the operator's own crsr_ platform credential — the host has nothing to deliver into it and must never overwrite it. It reaches the engine via plain ambient env inheritance (~/.agent-hippo/.env); engine.mjs resolveApiKey() reads and validates it.
